newsitem.title: UK: Switzerland best for liability insurers - report.
newsitem.headline: Switzerland best for liability insurers - report.

text.p: Switzerland stands out as the most attractive European market for general liability insurers, according to a report on Monday from management consultancy Datamonitor.
"Switzerland emerges as the most attractive general liability market in Europe followed closely by Austria and Germany," Datamonitor said in its report 'European General Insurance'.
Datamonitor ranked countries with an index of five key indicators -- market size, perceived growth potential, attractiveness of the legal environment, competition and profitability.
In contrast, Ireland and France were less attractive to general liability insurers because of a more flexible interpretation of the law and more volatile claims awards.

Changing trends in Europe will not lead to a 'liability crisis' as occurred in the U.S., Datamonitor said, but legal decision are pushing back the boundaries of liability at both national and European levels.
"Claims awareness is increasing rapidly in a number of European countries such as Germany, the Netherlands, France, Belgium and Spain," the report said.
"More worryingly for liability insurers, however, is that there is a clear trend towards reducing the burden of proof in favour of claimants."
However, Datamonitor said that awards will not escalate to U.S. levels because punitive damages are not awarded in Europe and there are few areas of joint and several liability.

The European general liability market is worth around $21.6 billion in gross written premiums and is dominated by Germany, Switzerland, the UK, France and Italy. It accounts for seven percent of the non-life insurance market, the report said.
